thread:
morgan: Following up from the authz postmortem. I want clear owners, measurable acceptance criteria, and a short remediation cadence. Posting a compact owner matrix below. Reply with 'take' + ETA or 'blocker: ...'.

ashley: take token validation tests + nightly synthetic. Acceptance: unit + e2e coverage + synthetic job that fails CI on regressions. ETA 2026-04-07. Blocker: need a staging service account.

kevin: take audit ingestion schema + alerting. Acceptance: ingestion rejects malformed events, metric authz.audit.dropped_count streams to Datadog, alert when >0 drops per 5m for critical services. ETA 2026-04-04.

priya: take secrets rotation automation + emergency playbook. Acceptance: cron-triggered k8s job + dry-run mode + one-click rollback script + notifications wired to pager. ETA 2026-04-18. Need infra to enable Vault service token for job.

laura: take on permissions audit and drift detection. Acceptance: nightly job that diffs live IAM vs canonical policy in git and opens high-priority tickets for risky changes. ETA 2026-04-10.

sam: I'll update the incident runbook and add a "recurrence signals" appendix: concrete thresholds, first-responder steps, and quick mitigation commands. ETA 2026-04-05.

morgan: Owner matrix recap: ashley (token tests/synthetic) 04-07; kevin (audit schema/alerts) 04-04; priya (rotation/playbook) 04-18; laura (perm-drift) 04-10; sam (runbook + signals) 04-05. Weekly 20m status check on Thursdays 11am PT until cleared. Post progress 24h before the sync.

ashley: Synthetic outline (WIP): issuance, refresh, expired token, malformed claims. Example check command: ```bash
HTTP_STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://authz.internal/validate)
if [ "$HTTP_STATUS" != "200" ]; then exit 2; fi
```
I'll request test SA today.

kevin: Schema validator prototype: ```python
REQUIRED=["user_id","token_id","action","ts","service"]
def valid(evt):
    return all(k in evt and evt[k] is not None for k in REQUIRED)
```
I'll add unit tests and a small sample stream to the ticket AUTHZ-1703.

priya: Playbook draft (brief): 1) mark impacted service degraded 2) run rotate --dry-run 3) promote to canary 4) smoke test 15m 5) promote or rollback. Will attach scripts + notification hook.

infra-bot: New ticket created: AUTHZ-1703 (audit ingestion hardening) assigned to kevin-team.

morgan: Infra ask: enable 2-week detailed audit retention for debug window (temporary). If infra agrees, we'll revert retention after all remediation items close.

laura: For drift detection I'll push a prototype that emits a short remediation plan per finding (who to contact, affected resources, suggested policy).

sam: Runbook additions I'll add: TL;DR, detection signals, immediate steps, eskalation matrix, and a checklist for post-change smoke jobs.

ashley: ack. Posting SA request and job YAML to AUTHZ-1706 later today.

kevin: ack. Attaching PR and test vectors before next sync.

priya: ack. Coordinating infra token; will post playbook draft by Friday EOD.

morgan: Thanks. If anyone needs to shift ETA, say so now so I can update the cadence. Otherwise I'll create the epics and the calendar invite for Thursdays 11am PT.

laura: small risk: existing IAM automation might auto-apply fixes and cause churn. Blocker: need a safe-window to test drift detector. ETA still 04-10 but will request a read-only test window.

morgan: Noted. We'll schedule a brief infra window for testing. Sam, can you add a line in the runbook about safe test windows?

sam: Will do. Adding a "test window" section and a contact list for infra approvals.

morgan: Closing: weekly sync pinned, owners to post progress 24h prior. I'll link epics and the incident ticket in the calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
